description: Coded disclosure-request TARGET registry entry — one record per organization × jurisdiction × legal-regime, holding the organization's 窓口 / 住所 / 連絡先 / メールアドレス / web-portal / required form / fee / statutory deadline so a himotoki cell can route + file a request procedurally (ADR-2605302130 §2). OPEN DATA (derived from the controller's own published privacy / FOIA page; provenance mandatory). CONSTITUTIONAL: `verificationStatus` gates live dispatch (G14) — `himotoki_dispatch` MUST refuse any entry that is `unverified-seed` or whose `lastVerified` is outside the freshness window. Seed entries enable routing design only; live filing requires `maintainer-verified` (FOIA) or `council-verified` (named private controller / DSAR).

organization.description: Target organization display name (e.g. 'Discord Inc.', 'LY Corporation', '内閣府')

did.description: Optional DID of the organization if registered

lei.description: Optional GLEIF LEI (corp.leiReference) for canonical identity

regime.description: The legal right being exercised against this target

channelType.description: HOW the request is filed (the 手続き channel)

portalUrl.description: Web portal / form URL (窓口, when channelType=web-portal/in-product-form)

contactEmail.description: Contact email (メールアドレス, when channelType=email)

formRef.description: chigiri procedure-template id used to compose this request

feeJpy.description: Statutory/handling fee in JPY if any (e.g. 行政文書開示 手数料 300/件 目安)

statutoryDeadlineDays.description: Statutory response-deadline clock in days (deadline_tracker basis)

stateAlignedFlag.description: CN-class / state-aligned target — pass-through to derived records (G13)

provenance.description: Source URL this entry was derived from (the controller's published privacy/FOIA page) — MANDATORY

lastVerified.description: When the contact data was last human-verified

verificationStatus.description: G14 dispatch gate. `unverified-seed` => routing-design only, NO live dispatch. `maintainer-verified` => FOIA dispatch allowed. `council-verified` => named-controller / DSAR dispatch allowed.
